newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran welcomes Hong Kong's return to China - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran welcomes Hong Kong's return to China - IRNA.

text.p: Iran welcomed the return of Hong Kong to China and considered the handover a great success for the Beijing government, Iran's deputy foreign minister said on Sunday.

"Alaeddin Boroujerdi said Sunday that Iran considered the process of the return of Hong Kong to China a very important development in the political scene of the world," the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.
"The event is an end to one of hundreds of examples of British colonialism in the world and the Islamic Republic of Iran is pleased with such a great success," IRNA quoted Boroujerdi as saying.
The deputy foreign minister also said the time was ripe for closer relations between the two states.
U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen said this month Iran had successfully tested a new air launched anti-ship cruise missile obtained from China.
Iran said earlier in June Beijing had agreed to increase Chinese imports of Iranian crude to 200,000 barrels per day in 2000 from 70,000 now.
